segments.t: Foolish Galatians,
segments.note: Ὦ は英語に現れないので同乗させる

segments.t: who has bewitched you
not to obey the truth,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「not to obey the truth」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
segments.note: 「among you」は英語の補い（οἷς のほぐしに含む）

segments.t: I just want to learn this from you:
Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
Are you so foolish?
Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
segments.note: 与格 πνεύματι／σαρκὶ を「in the Spirit／in the flesh」とほぐす

segments.t: Did you suffer so many things in vain,
segments.note: τοσαῦτα を「so many things」とほぐす

segments.t: if it is indeed in vain?
He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you,
segments.note: δυνάμεις を「miracles」と訳す

segments.t: does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
segments.note: 「does he do it」は英語の補い

segments.t: Even so, Abraham “believed God,
segments.note: καθὼς を「Even so」とほぐす

segments.t: and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
The Scripture, foreseeing
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: that God would justify the Gentiles by faith,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ὁ θεὸς が主語として前に出る）

segments.t: preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying,
segments.note: 「the Good News」は προευηγγελίσατο に含まれる。「saying」は ὅτι（引用導入）

segments.t: “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse.
For it is written,
segments.note: ὅτι（12番）は引用導入で英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（δῆλον が文末→文の述部へ）

segments.t: for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
segments.note: ὅτι を「for」と訳す

segments.t: The law is not of faith, but,
“The man who does them will live by them.”
segments.note: Ὁ ποιήσας を「The man who does them」とほぐす

segments.t: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us.
For it is written,
“Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え

segments.t: that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
Brothers, speaking of human terms,
segments.note: κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω を「speaking of human terms」とほぐす

segments.t: though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え

segments.t: He doesn’t say,
“To descendants”, as of many,
but as of one, “To your offspring”,
which is Christ.
Now I say this:
A covenant confirmed beforehand by God
in Christ,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「in Christ」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: the law, which came four hundred thirty years after,
does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise;
but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え

segments.t: Then why is there the law?
segments.note: 「is there」は英語の補い

segments.t: It was added because of transgressions,
until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made.
It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
segments.note: 「between」は英語の補い

segments.t: Is the law then against the promises of God?
Certainly not!
For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
segments.note: ὄντως を「most certainly」と訳す

segments.t: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin,
that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
segments.note: πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ（属格）を WEB は「faith in Jesus Christ」と訳す

segments.t: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
segments.note: εἰς τὴν μέλλουσαν πίστιν を「for the faith which should afterwards be revealed」とほぐす

segments.t: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ,
segments.note: εἰς Χριστόν を「to bring us to Christ」とほぐす

segments.t: that we might be justified by faith.
But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
There is neither Jew nor Greek,
there is neither slave nor free man,
segments.note: 「man」は英語の補い

segments.t: there is neither male nor female;
for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
